args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Note from Sofia Marchetti on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals."
- The saved report needs its label updated so it matches the new name.
- Can you check whether other saved reports or digests still use the old Covey & Lark label?
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll

args.text:
@Bettina Kroll, the draft is saved in my mailbox. It's addressed to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup." Nothing has been sent.

The body is Sofia's note, with your two lines added: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. It has no money terms. Someone needs to send it from the draft folder.
